read.thesis: EPAM cut FY26 reported revenue growth to 3.2–4.2% as North America stalls and large AI deals slip to 1H27; AI-native revenue of $160M and the $600M target held, but DSO rose to 82 days and FCF was negative.

utilisation.quote: Utilization was 78.3% compared to 78.1% in Q2 of last year and 77% in Q1 2026.

triggers.label: FY26 revenue growth cut to 3.2–4.2%
triggers.quote: Revenue growth will now be in the range of 3.2% to 4.2%.

triggers.label: Large deals slip to 1H27
triggers.quote: we now expect more meaningful revenue contribution starting in the first half of 2027 versus the second half of 2026.

triggers.label: DSO 82 days vs 76 in Q1
triggers.quote: At the end of Q2, DSO was 82 days and compares to 76 days for Q1 2026 and 78 days for the same quarter last year.

triggers.label: Non-GAAP gross margin 32.0% vs 30.1%
triggers.quote: Non-GAAP gross margin for the quarter was 32% compared to 30.1% for the same period a year ago

guidance.quote: Revenue growth will now be in the range of 3.2% to 4.2%.
non-GAAP diluted EPS will now be in the range of $13.08 to $13.24 for the full year
we now expect to operate at the high end of our previous adjusted IFO range of 15% to 16%
keeping us on track to meet our goal of $600 million in AI native revenues in 2026.
we are now expecting our free cash flow conversion rate in 2026 to be around 70%, below our typical 80% to 90% conversion rate.
We expect revenue to be in the range of $1.410 billion to $1.425 billion

prior_guidance_check.quote: keeping us on track to meet our goal of $600 million in AI native revenues in 2026.

red_flags.label: Revenue guide cut; North America stalling
red_flags.quote: North America is not growing fast enough.

red_flags.label: Negative FCF and rising DSO
red_flags.quote: Free cash flow was negative $18 million compared to positive free cash flow of $43 million in the same quarter last year.

evasions.quote: It may look like a price haircut if you're sitting there delivering managed services today.
we will update you in, I think, on the next earnings call how successful we have been in closing them and converting them.
